sources.citation: George Sperling (1960). The information available in brief visual presentations. Psychological Monographs: General and Applied.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1960) in Psychological Monographs: General and Applied establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Jay Friedenberg (2013). A Fitting Tribute to a Great Scientist: Research Inspired by George Sperling. PsycCRITIQUES.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2013) in PsycCRITIQUES extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Max Coltheart (1980). Iconic memory and visible persistence. Perception & Psychophysics.
sources.notes: Max Coltheart's foundational review dissociating neural visible persistence from informational iconic storage in Sperling's partial-report paradigm.

sources.citation: Vincent Di Lollo (1980). Temporal integration in visual memory. Journal of Experimental Psychology: General.
sources.notes: Vincent Di Lollo's temporal-integration experiments demonstrating that iconic persistence locks to stimulus onset rather than offset.

sources.citation: Martin Graziano, Mariano Sigman (2009). The Spatial and Temporal Construction of Confidence in the Visual Scene. PLoS ONE.
sources.notes: Modern psychophysical and cortical mapping of letter-array decay across the partial-report visual buffer.
